en.quote: And of Zion it shall be said, This and that man was born in her: and the highest himself shall establish her.
en.riddle: This and that man was born in her
en.speaker: it shall be said

he.quote: וּֽלֲצִיּוֹן יֵאָמַר אִישׁ וְאִישׁ יֻלַּד־בָּהּ וְהוּא יְכוֹנְנֶהָ עֶלְיֽוֹן
he.speaker: יֵאָמַר
